entries.jp: 「通行証を見せろ。\f
entries.en: "Show me your Pass.
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: 何？　持ってないだと？\n
entries.en: What? You don't have one? Then I can't let you through!"
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: ならば通すわけにはいかん！」\f
entries.speaker: 何？　持ってないだと？

entries.jp: 「通行証を見せろ。\f
entries.en: "Show me your Pass.
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.en: ......Hm, very well. Go on through."
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: うむ、いいだろう。通れ」\f
「この先は首都バルクルーサだ。\n
entries.en: "Beyond here lies Balkrutha, the Capital. If you want through, bring a Pass!"
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: 通りたければ、通行証を持って来い！」\f
「通行証は持ってきたか？」\f
entries.en: "Did you bring a Pass?"
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: 「石段を降りると、マッカロックの村へ\n
entries.en: "Go down the stone steps and you'll reach the road to the village of Maccaloc."
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: 続く道だ」\f
「むっ、この通行証は・・・\n
entries.en: "Hm? This Pass is... Very well, go on through."
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: いいだろう、通れ」\f
「マッカロックまで行ってきたのか？\n
entries.en: "Went to Maccaloc? Well, aren't you a dedicated one. The army's camped there, so ya couldn't get in, right?
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: ご苦労なことだな。\n
あそこは軍が駐留中だから入れなかっ\n
entries.speaker: ご苦労なことだな。

entries.jp: たろ？\f
普段の行いが悪いから、そーゆーこと\n
entries.en: That's what ya get for always actin' up, see."
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: になるんだぜ」\f
「通れ」\f
entries.en: "Go on through."
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: 「通行証があるだと？\n
entries.en: "You have a Pass, you say? That one was issued in Allvaine. That Pass won't get you through here."
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: それはオールバインの発行ではないか。\n
その通行証では、ここは通れんな」\f
「地下牢は立入禁止だ！\n
entries.en: "The dungeon is off-limits! Get out of here!"
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: あっちへ行け！」\f
「牢屋だと？\n
entries.en: "The cells? Yeah, that's right. This is where we toss the wanted crooks we nab in the city. So what?
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: ああ、そうとも。ここは街で捕まえた、\n
おたずね者なんかをブチ込んでるンだ\n
が？\f
あン？　牢屋を見たい？\n
entries.en: Huh? Ya wanna see the cells? What're you playin' at, punk?"
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: 何、考えてンだきさま」\f
entries.speaker: あン？　牢屋を見たい？

entries.en: "Ohh... So ya really wanna see the cells that bad, huh? Hmm hmm hmm hmm hmm hmm. ...Hmph!
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: そんなに牢屋を見たいのか。\n
ふんふんふんふんふんふん。\n
entries.speaker: そんなに牢屋を見たいのか。
ふんふんふんふんふんふん。

entries.jp: いいだろう、中へ入りな」\f
entries.en: Fine, in ya go."
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: 「入れてやるって言ってんだ、さっさと\n
entries.en: "I said I'm lettin' ya in. Now hurry up and get in there."
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: 入れよ」\f
「首都バルクルーサは山上都市だ。\n
entries.en: "Balkrutha, the Capital, is a mountaintop city. The city itself is an impregnable fortress.
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: 街そのものが難攻不落の要塞だよ。\f
これを自慢するのが楽しみでね」\f
entries.en: I do love bragging about it."
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: 「我々は、首都に入り込もうとする不審\n
entries.en: "We are here to crack down on any suspicious types trying to slip into the capital."
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: な輩を取り締まっておるのだ」\f
「知ってますか？　なんでも、もうすぐ\n
entries.en: "Have you heard? They say martial law will be declared in the city any day now. My, my, dangerous times!"
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: 街に戒厳令がしかれるそうですよ。\n
いやァ、物騒なこってすなァ」\f
「街じゃ、あっちこっちに兵士ばっかり\n
entries.en: "Soldiers standin' around all over the city. Can't get a lick of work done, so I figured I'd try elsewhere... Eh? My line of work?
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op

entries.jp: 立ってやがる。とても仕事にならねー\n
から、他へ行くことにしたのさ・・・\n
え？　おれの仕事？\f
野暮なことは聞きっこなしだぜ」\f
entries.en: Now, don't go askin' nosy questions, pal."
entries.notes: not on a walked path: file scan found this message op
